question: What is the coil of wire in the electric room heater known as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Element**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** wire coil of a heater** is also sometimes referred to as the **heating element.**
 
• It is frequently constructed of** rare materials** like **platinum, tungsten, etc**.
 
• A heating element uses the J**oule heating process** to transform** electrical energy into heat.**
 
• Nowadays, a coil of wire is heated by an** electric current **and utilized to** produce and sustain high temperatures **throughout many** scientific procedures.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cell:**

 
 
• A cell is a **solitary electrical energy source** that generates **current **through chemical reactions.
 
• "Electrical power supply" refers to an** electrical cell.**
 
 
 
• **Fuse:**
 
 
• A fuse is typically formed of a **current-conducting strip or wire **of readily** flammable metal.**
 
• It melts whenever the circuit it is part of is designed to carry a** current greater than **that for which the **fuse is intended, interrupting the circuit.**
 
 
 
• **Switch:**
 
 
• An electrical part called a switch is used to **turn electrical equipment on and off. **
